subject: Ship
text: The Ship cannot go down streams and can only disembark at a port or with a Canoe.

evidence.quote: before climbing onto it, a few rules to know about the Ship; 1) It can not go down streams (differently coloured than oceans), and 2) You may only disembark at a port (or with a Canoe, but you are not that far yet in the game).

subject: Ship
text: Sail west and south along the coastline to find a port near a large forest leading south to Elfland.

evidence.quote: Anyway, head out of the small bay and head west along the coast line, turning south when the ocean opens up. Continue south and west along the coast to find a port near a large forest. Land on shore and head south through the forest to find the central point of the kingdom of Elfland!

subject: Prince
text: The sleeping Prince in Elfland castle was put to sleep by Astos and requires the HERB to awaken.

evidence.quote: You should visit the castle first to learn of many things (including a sleeping Prince who needs the HERB because Astos put him to sleep, but Matoya has HERB but needs the CRYSTAL, and no one knows where Astos is!).
